plain: To take back a statement or claim

webster.text: To recall, as a declaration, words or saying; to disavow; to recant; as, to retract an accusation, charge or assertion.

example.quote: They will say, You have signed and sealed, and you cannot now retract.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 25, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
